temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted in October and November 2014.

assessment.summary: This study investigated insecticide resistance and target-site mutations in Anopheles gambiae (s.l.) populations from Kedougou and Wassadou-Badi, Senegal, in 2014. The study found resistance to pyrethroids, DDT, bendiocarb, and fenitrothion. Genotyping revealed the presence of Vgsc-1014F, Vgsc-1014S, Ace-1 (G119S), and Rdl (A296S/G) mutations, with varying frequencies across species and locations.
